name: 梁斯寧
objective: This course aims to develop students' English language skills and communicative competence for effective communication. Centered around the fields of science, technology and engineering, the materials and activities in the course are designed to prepare students to understand and discuss the topics of the fields.

彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Week 17: Students independently compile a discipline-specific vocabulary learning record. They select and study words or terms relevant to their field of study.

Week 18: Students complete an individual reflection on their current vocabulary-learning practices, difficulties in learning technical vocabulary, and strategies they may adopt in future learning.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Students will be able to:
identify English vocabulary relevant to their academic discipline;
distinguish between the general and discipline-specific meanings of selected words;
investigate the collocations and contextual uses of technical vocabulary;
use appropriate resources to verify vocabulary information; and
reflect on and develop strategies for independent vocabulary learning.

Submission:
Discipline-specific vocabulary learning record 
Vocabulary learning reflec
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          10% of the course grade

This is an English for Specific/Academic Purposes (ESP/EAP) course. All textbooks, teaching materials, handouts, and presentation slides are in English. English is used for at least 90% of classroom instruction and teacher–student interaction.
本課程為專業英文（ESP/EAP）課程，教材、講義及簡報均採全英文；課堂授課及師生互動之英語使用比例 90% (含) 以上。
